summary: Built bench/zonoid_bench/report.py (stdlib-only, ~400 LOC). Generalises agent-memory/scorer.py into a reusable SDK scaffold: write_results/load_results (.jsonl I/O), token_f1() (deterministic Porter-stem F1 ported from scorer.py), judge_correctness() (LLM-judge via judge.claude_p, LoCoMo/LongMemEval rubric with abstention handling), score() (three pluggable hooks: LLM-judge accuracy, token-F1, pass/fail via record.correct for coding benches; per-arm + per-category aggregation), score_file() convenience wrapper, render_report() (report.json machine + report.md human with optional competitor_bar), scorecard_section() (SOUND contrast-axis framing: internal arms table separate from competitor bar table with explicit provenance + no-overclaiming disclaimer). Verification: _verify_report.py ran 32 checks across synthetic 3-arm dataset (our-way/search/cold); all passed including F1 edge cases, pass_rate=0.5 on cold arm, report.json/md round-trip, scorecard Markdown structure. Commit b63998d on orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-20.
